elements.description: An isometric stack of layers beside a list; the chosen entry lifts its layer. Steps through them on its own.

properties.name: items
properties.default: [ { title: "Triggered by events", hint: "Webhooks", icon: "bolt" }, { title: "Grounded in your data", hint: "Context", icon: "database" }, { title: "Connected to your apps", hint: "APIs", icon: "plug" }, { title: "Works with any model", hint: "Routing", icon: "spark" }, { title: "Traced at every step", hint: "Logs", icon: "pulse" }, ]
properties.description: Up to five entries, top layer first

properties.name: interval
properties.description: Time per entry while it plays on its own, in ms

properties.name: rounds
properties.description: How many times it steps through all entries on its own before it rests (default 2; Infinity keeps going, 0 never steps)

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-index-change
events.description: Cancelable, before the chosen entry changes; detail: LayerStackIndexChange ({ index, user })

props.name: index
props.description: The chosen entry (controlled when defined: it doesn't step on its own then)

props.name: defaultIndex
props.description: Entry to start on when uncontrolled

props.name: onIndexChange
props.description: Reports every change of the chosen entry – picked by the user or stepped to on its own

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called when an entry is picked by the user
